messages:
Priyanka (CSM): Quick flag  ZenithAI showed a ~65% drop in /summarize calls starting Monday. New procurement lead (Maya) is running a cost-first bakeoff with CompetitorAlpha. Renewal conversation in 7 weeks. Need rapid triage and an offer to keep them from shortlisting. :rotating_light:
Diego (AM): Thanks. Any immediate churn or auth changes?
Priyanka (CSM): Seats steady. PM says theyre pausing pipelines to test CompetitorAlpha on a sample run. Link: https://redwood.dash/zenith/overview. Quick snapshot:
```
This week: daily /summarize jobs 8.9k -> 3.1k
Top cost: /summarize (82%)
Median tokens/job: 9.6k -> 7.8k
Error rate: no change
```
Felix (Solutions Eng): Are they reporting any quality issues or is this purely price-driven?
Priyanka (CSM): Price-first. They did mention one formatting regression with their custom post-process that surfaced last month; procurement is using that as leverage.
Harini (RevOps): I can run a price comparison and show impact of enabling reserved-burst + prefix cache + int8 quant for the summarizer. If we can demonstrate ~25% unit cost improvement with minimal quality impact, that should help. I can post a short CSV by 11:30am PT.
Diego (AM): Felix  please prepare a 10-slide (very short) tech appendix: exact config changes, expected token/GPU delta, latency tradeoffs, and mitigation for the formatting regression. 20 minutes for procurement.
Felix (Solutions Eng): On it. I'll include before/after token-per-job, expected tail latency, and a small reranker + formatter check to catch the regression. ETA 11:15am PT.
Priyanka (CSM): I'll reach out to Maya for the regression repro and her acceptance criteria. Also offer to run a 48-hour canary if we can provision a reserved pool quickly.
infra-bot: [canary] reserved-pool zenith-pilot-2024-09-02 provisioned by felix at 2024-09-02T18:02:12Z
Harini (RevOps): Initial numbers (rough): baseline $0.029/token -> optimized $0.022/token (~24% reduction). CompetitorAlpha quoted $0.019/token but without streaming and with export limits. Posting details in Drive.
Diego (AM): Action owners:
- Felix: config list + tech appendix + risk notes (11:15am PT)
- Harini: cleaned TCO + contract excerpt + competitor comparison (11:30am PT)
- Priyanka: collect regression repro + schedule 30m canary sync with Maya (EOD)
- Diego: draft a 2-week pilot offer (reserved burst + bundled observability + 10% credit) and exec note (by TOM)
Any objections?
Felix (Solutions Eng): No objections. Will flag any quantization caveats; reranker may add small token overhead.
Priyanka (CSM): If cost delta looks good, can we include a controlled fallback to a smaller model family if they need immediate cost relief? Diego, you good owning fallback commercial terms?
Diego (AM): Yes. I'll include a fallback plan in the offer and a short SLA addendum for the pilot. Legal ping once Harini uploads the contract excerpt.
Priyanka (CSM): Thanks team. I'll update after the canary sync and post the regression sample when Maya replies. :thumbsup:
